description.narrative:
The Ministry of Manpower adopted a new national productivity training standard using the ILO SCORE model and quality assurance to improve productivity. SCORE Training Methodology is promoted as one of the Ministry of Manpower' productivity training tool. SCORE has been delivered by at least 8 organization included Public Training Center in Semarang, Central Java.
2.000 young people, women, rural residents, including people with disabilities, PLHIV and Refugees are trained on entrepreneurship. 10% of the participants expects to open a business by the end of the year The ILO developed partnership with 8 new organizations that will deliver ILO SCORE Training for enterprises. SCORE Trainer certification and quality assurance for independent training providers is ensured.
SCORE Indonesia has now 30 certified SCORE Trainers, 4 Expert Trainers and the partners can independently send the document of certification's candidate direct to ILO SCORE Geneva. Innovative entrepreneurship training for vulnerable community was showcased, in response to the covid-19 pandemic.
